name: r3_warden_chain
description: Warden consolidation fixture: one safe candidate plus three that each trip a DIFFERENT warden (superseded -> currentness; loop -> exhaustion; wrong-repo -> scope). Proves each single warden misses the others' cases while the chain catches all without blocking the safe one. Grounded in the R3 fixture families (floor supersession, recency loop, rename/wrong-scope).
